title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1980-09-30
source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard(shinid:132375) SBD -> Cassette Master -> FLAC, FLAC -> Adobe Audition v5.5 -> Samplitude Pro X2 Suite -> FLAC and Audience(shinid:089554) Master Cassette > Nakamichi 700s > Sony TC D-5, Pioneer RT-701 Reel to Reel > Soundblaster Soundcard > Soundforge > CD; CD Extraction with EAC > TLH > FLAC level 8

ai_review.summary: An almost sacred, ultra‑intimate performance captured in a superb matrix mix that puts the listener right in the sweet spot.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this recording’s ability to let the music breathe – Dave’s superlative matrix mix delivers crystal‑clear intimacy with the hush of a respectful Bay Area crowd. The show is described as near‑sacred, making it a must‑listen for anyone who wishes they’d been at that legendary Warfield run.

ai_rating.rationale: Two five‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the exceptional matrix recording, with no criticisms noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Superlative mix; crisp, intimate sound that captures crowd ambience and lets the music breathe. No reported artifacts or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The performance is highlighted for its hushed, respectful atmosphere and overall intimacy; reviewers imply a seamless, emotionally resonant flow throughout the night.
